description: Object /build (spec 19.15, 19.20): the build operations of lw build, lw clean and lw reset as task-streamed methods, and the editor's configure; the protocol-10 build, clean and reset requests stay as their v0 aliases. Each replies with the operation's outcome (accepted with the task_id, refused, declined, confirm) and streams the task on the transport's task stream. build, configure and clean take a profile or configuration units (units, exclusive with profile: both is invalid_args; spec 19.15 Editor scopes and configure).

UnitRef.description: A configuration unit: its id (e.g. a view.ProjectsIndex/1 record's active.unit_id) or its project key and configuration-unit key (as in the task meta's units).

Units.description: The configuration units the operation runs on instead of a profile (non-empty; not with profile), each with the tool its unit records.

build.description: Build the profile (lw build [<profile>] [--target <name>]... [--force] [--reconfigure] [-v] [-- <args>]), or the configuration units (units).

profile.description: The profile (absent: the active one), resolved as the in-process command resolves it.

interactive.description: The client can ask the user (a terminal); without it a missing profile is refused, never onboarded.

command.description: The command name the task's lines quote (lw build, ...).

targets.description: Only these build targets (--target): a name as lw build --target reads it, or one project's target.

jobs.description: The build tool's parallelism for this build only (the editor's serial -j1 build), passed as the in-process build passes its parallel-jobs option.

extra.description: Arguments passed to the build tool (after --).

configure.description: Configure the profile (or the units): the configure step of every unit of the scope, also one already configured, and no build (the editor's configure action; the CLI has none). The outcomes of build.

profile.description: The profile (absent: the active one), resolved as the in-process command resolves it.

interactive.description: The client can ask the user (a terminal); without it a missing profile is refused, never onboarded.

command.description: The command name the task's lines quote.

clean.description: Clean the profile's (or the units') build directories (lw clean [<profile>]); nothing to clean is the refused result.

profile.description: The profile (absent: the active one), resolved as the in-process command resolves it.

interactive.description: The client can ask the user (a terminal); without it a missing profile is refused, never onboarded.

command.description: The command name the task's lines quote (lw build, ...).

reset.description: Hard-reset build directories (lw reset [<profile> | --all] [-y], spec 16.30): without yes the result is confirm with the plan's lines and token; with yes (and that token as plan) the reset runs as a task. Nothing to reset is refused with stream out and exit code 0.

profile.description: The profile (absent: the active one), resolved as the in-process command resolves it.

interactive.description: The client can ask the user (a terminal); without it a missing profile is refused, never onboarded.

command.description: The command name the task's lines quote (lw build, ...).

all.description: Every profile's build directories (not with profile).

plan.description: The token of the confirm result the user accepted; a changed plan is refused.
